run_interactive_cli: run the MetaSeq interactive CLI to generate text from user prompts via command line
run_worker_main: run the distributed worker to load a model and generate text from broadcasted prompts
run_input_loop: run the input loop to collect multi-line user prompts with colored terminal display
review_worker_main: review the worker_main function that handles distributed model loading and text generation
review_cli_main: review the cli_main function that parses arguments and launches distributed inference workers
